skill.displayName: Vidu API special effects generation capability, with over 400 built-in effect templates covering styles such as transformation, fun, and holidays.
skill.summary: Vidu AI 场景特效生成。支持389个预设特效模板，包括华丽变身、情人节、风格魔盒、缤纷佳节等。对话式调用，自动匹配模板。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of vidu-template-generate.

- Introduces Vidu AI scene effect generator with 389 preset templates (e.g., transformations, Valentine’s, festivals, and fun effects)  
- Conversational interface matching user requests to templates automatically  
- Strict requirement: Only user-uploaded photos may be used (reminds user to upload if missing)  
- API domain auto-selected based on user language (China: api.vidu.cn, other: api.vidu.com)  
- Includes detailed instructions for template categories, parameters, and CLI/API usage  
- Robust error handling and output standards with Markdown file references and 24hr video link validity
